subject: GGIR Part 6: SRI Not Calculating 2/3 of Time

messages.author: 3203e1e8ded9afce
messages.subject: GGIR Part 6: SRI Not Calculating 2/3 of Time
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run modes 1-6, but I am having some difficulty with ~1/2 my samples. For some individuals, when I run the analysis, it comes out with this error and does not return any output: 

 Report part 6
 loading all the milestone data from part 6 this can take a few minutes

________________________________________________________________________________
 Generate visual reports
Error in legend("topright", legend = legendnames, col = legendcolors,  :
  unused argument (title.font = 2)

For other individuals, it runs fine, and I get the requested outputs. Here is the script I am running: 

try(GGIR(datadir=input_file, mode = 1:6, do.report = c(2,4,5,6), part6CR=TRUE, part6DFA=F, outputdir = output_file,
     timewindow='MM', desiredtz='America/New_York',
     configtz='America/New_York', studyname = tmp.name))

Where tmp.name is the name of the participant, input_file is the directory with the BIN file, and output_file is the output directory. 

Has anyone else run into this issue? Is there a quick way to resolve this? 

Thanks,
J Dylan Weissenkampen
NRSA Postdoctoral Fellow
University of Pennsylvania

Hi Dylan,

I drafted the GGIR update for you and your colleagues to test. It is not part of a GGIR release yet and there is no point in reaching out to the GGIR google group for help as nobody here will know what you are referring to.

Please correspond with me directly via direct message if you have questions / problems.

What I will need is a reproducible example. For example a test file to reproduce the error.

Thanks,

Vincent
